n2065223ce6.headline: HECS debt bill passes through parliament | Midday News Bulletin 31 July 2025
n2065223ce6.summary: A bill reducing HECS student debts passed through Australian parliament, meaning millions of students will have their debts reduced.
n2065223ce6.why: HECS-HELP is the Australian government's student loan scheme, and changes to it affect government finances and graduate household budgets.

ne60fe74a12.headline: KRA Issues New Directives Affecting Traders
ne60fe74a12.summary: The Kenya Revenue Authority has issued new directives that are set to affect thousands of importers. The source article gives no further detail on the measures.
ne60fe74a12.why: Import rules and tax directives shape costs and compliance for importers and traders, which in turn affects trade flows and company margins in Kenya.

n285e6785a7.headline: Royalty Management portfolio company TR Mining discovers Rare Earth Elements in Jamaican Deposit
n285e6785a7.summary: TR Mining, a portfolio company of Royalty Management Holdings, has discovered rare earth elements in a Jamaican deposit. The announcement was made by Royalty Management's CEO.
n285e6785a7.why: Rare earth elements are used in magnets and electronics, so new deposits are watched for potential supply relevant to clean energy and defence industries.

na42758c8a3.headline: The R145bn Transnet back brace to fix the spine of the South African economy
na42758c8a3.summary: A Daily Maverick report examines the state's R145 billion financial intervention for Transnet, the state rail and port operator. It frames the package as a possible lifeline for the South African economy.
na42758c8a3.why: Transnet runs South Africa's rail freight and major ports, so its performance affects trade logistics and the wider economy.

n3e6f99e0c8.headline: Lithuanian PM Paluckas resigning amid allegations of shady business dealings
n3e6f99e0c8.summary: Prime Minister Gintautas Paluckas has announced his intention to resign as head of government and as leader of his party. The resignation follows allegations of questionable business dealings.
n3e6f99e0c8.why: Political instability in a eurozone member can affect investor sentiment toward the country's policy direction and governance.

nae358a1fc0.headline: Euronext's Acquisition of ATHEX: A Major Boost for Greece
nae358a1fc0.summary: Greek Finance Minister Kyriakos Pierrakakis commented on Euronext's acquisition of the Athens Stock Exchange, calling it a significant step for Greece's economic future.
nae358a1fc0.why: Euronext is a pan-European exchange operator, and its acquisition of a national exchange would change ownership and market infrastructure in Greece.

n3304be8b60.headline: Reconnaissance Energy Africa spuds Kavango West 1X exploration well in Namibia
n3304be8b60.summary: Reconnaissance Energy Africa announced that drilling has commenced at the Kavango West 1X exploration well in Namibia. The company is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange and OTCQX.
n3304be8b60.why: Reconnaissance Energy Africa is an oil and gas explorer, and exploration well results can materially change the value of its prospects.

n409fa8d252.headline: China suggests lasers and stealth submarines to counter Musk’s Starlink satellites
n409fa8d252.summary: Chinese teams are reportedly exploring methods to neutralise Elon Musk's Starlink satellite network. The proposals include lasers and stealth submarines.
n409fa8d252.why: Starlink is SpaceX's satellite internet network, and its military and commercial role makes it a focus of geopolitical competition in space.

nddb68ae9f8.headline: Eurobank Raises Loan Target to €4B, Announces €170M Dividend
nddb68ae9f8.summary: Eurobank raised its 2025 loan growth target to €4 billion and announced a €170 million interim dividend. The moves are part of its shareholder returns strategy.
nddb68ae9f8.why: Eurobank is a major Greek systemic bank with operations across southeastern Europe. Loan targets and dividends indicate its growth plans and capital distribution to shareholders.

impacts.name: Eurobank
impacts.why: The raised loan target and interim dividend signal growth plans and shareholder payouts.

nf5106f7e07.headline: Athens Bourse Hits 15-Year High as Market Climbs
nf5106f7e07.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange closed at 15-year highs as the General Index rose 0.89%. It marked nine straight months of gains.
nf5106f7e07.why: The Athens General Index tracks Greece's main listed companies and is a benchmark for the Greek equity market. Sustained gains reflect investor sentiment toward Greek stocks.

n7ed6ea771d.headline: Colombia Challenges Israeli Impunity from Above and Below
n7ed6ea771d.summary: President Petro is ramping up efforts to halt Colombian coal exports to Israel. Activists are pushing for decisive action on the issue.
n7ed6ea771d.why: Colombia is a significant coal exporter, and export restrictions affect global thermal coal supply and trade flows. Trade policy decisions can move commodity buyers and shipping routes.

n753eea3d83.headline: The Fed holds interest rates steady. And, Texas releases bid for new redistricting map
n753eea3d83.summary: The Federal Reserve voted to keep interest rates unchanged, despite the president calling for lower rates. The report also covered a Texas Republican proposal for a new redistricting map.
n753eea3d83.why: The Federal Reserve sets the US benchmark interest rate, which influences borrowing costs, bond yields, and equity valuations across global markets.
n753eea3d83.why_moved: The Fed kept rates unchanged despite public calls from the president for lower rates, a decision that bears directly on expectations for borrowing costs.

n5089889b59.headline: Eurobank Posts €691M Net Profit in H1 2025
n5089889b59.summary: Eurobank reported €691 million in net profit for the first half of 2025, citing strong international performance. The bank also upgraded its credit expansion targets.
n5089889b59.why: Eurobank is a Greek systemic bank, and its earnings and lending targets indicate the health of the Greek and wider southeastern European banking sector.

impacts.why: The bank reported a first-half 2025 net profit of €691 million and raised its credit expansion targets.

nbcad8785ff.headline: CNMC announces remuneration proposal for 2026-2031 regulatory period: Redeia's revenues would grow to €1.858 billion
nbcad8785ff.summary: Spain's CNMC published a remuneration proposal for Redeia's electricity transmission network for 2026-2031. Redeia's revenues would grow to €1.858 billion under the proposal.
nbcad8785ff.why: Redeia operates Spain's electricity transmission grid, and regulated remuneration determines its allowed returns and revenues.

n02331d0e5d.headline: Athens Stock Market Hits 15-Year High Amid Record Rally
n02331d0e5d.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange closed at 15-year highs, with the general index near 2,000 points. The gains follow a historic nine-month bullish run.
n02331d0e5d.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market, and its general index tracks the country's listed companies.

na454bd6949.headline: Costamare orders first new boxships for seven years
na454bd6949.summary: Costamare has confirmed eight-year charters for four 3,100 teu container vessels from an unnamed Chinese builder. The order marks the company's first new boxship orders in seven years.
na454bd6949.why: Costamare is a Monaco-based containership owner that leases vessels to liner operators. Newbuild orders and long charters signal capacity and fleet renewal in container shipping.

n6c6dfebe7f.headline: Capital Clean Energy Carriers ‘encouraged’ by brighter LNG shipping picture
n6c6dfebe7f.summary: Capital Clean Energy Carriers is encouraged by a brighter LNG shipping outlook, citing an uptick in scrapping and a slowdown in new orders. These trends are seen as supportive over the longer term.
n6c6dfebe7f.why: Capital Clean Energy Carriers is a Greek owner of liquefied natural gas carriers. Vessel supply, scrapping and newbuild orders drive charter rates and earnings in LNG shipping.

n54ad649530.headline: Public Group Reports Strong 2024 Growth Amid Store Expansion
n54ad649530.summary: Public Group achieved improved financial performance in 2024. The company invested €10 million in expanding its physical stores across Greece and Cyprus.
n54ad649530.why: Public is a Greek retailer selling consumer electronics and related products. Store expansion and profitability are key indicators of its growth in the Greek and Cypriot retail market.

n567d35cdd3.headline: Trump ramps up trade war with Canada over Palestine
n567d35cdd3.summary: President Trump warned it will be very hard to reach a trade deal with Canada after the Canadian leader's position on Palestine. The remarks escalate tensions between the two trading partners.
n567d35cdd3.why: Canada and the US have one of the largest trading relationships in the world, so trade disputes affect cross-border supply chains and the Canadian dollar.

n3643432146.headline: UK households rush to hoard cash over change not seen for two years
n3643432146.summary: The Office for National Statistics reported that the UK household savings ratio rose to 11.1% in the first quarter of 2024. Households are saving a larger share of income.
n3643432146.why: The savings ratio indicates how much income households set aside rather than spend, which influences consumer spending and economic growth.

nfbc0071cc7.headline: So why are there 8000 unsold apartments in Melbourne? Here’s what the property analysts say
nfbc0071cc7.summary: Property industry sources say Melbourne has 8,000 empty and unsold apartments. There are rising calls for the government to buy them for public or affordable housing.
nfbc0071cc7.why: Unsold apartment stock affects developer cash flow, construction activity and the balance between supply and demand in the housing market.

n5dda9f0be9.headline: Trump again slams Fed chair Powell after rates hold
n5dda9f0be9.summary: US President Donald Trump again criticised Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell a day after the central bank held interest rates steady in a 9-2 vote.
n5dda9f0be9.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, bond yields and asset valuations worldwide.

n056ee01dee.headline: Trump seeks to use Canada’s recognition of Palestinian state as leverage in trade talks
n056ee01dee.summary: Canada announced it will recognize a Palestinian state, a move that the US administration said will make it very hard to reach a trade agreement. The AP report cites this as leverage in trade negotiations.
n056ee01dee.why: Canada is one of the United States' largest trading partners, so trade-talk setbacks can affect tariffs, cross-border supply chains and sectors such as autos, energy and agriculture.

n594bf3d346.headline: U.S. sanctions massive Iranian oil shipping network
n594bf3d346.summary: The United States sanctioned dozens of individuals, entities and vessels accused of being part of an Iranian oil and petroleum shipping network. The measures target the logistics behind Iranian crude exports.
n594bf3d346.why: US sanctions on Iranian oil shipping restrict the movement of Iranian crude and can tighten global supply, influencing oil prices and tanker markets.

n03e1ee9b9c.headline: Lebanon passes banking restructuring law in key reform
n03e1ee9b9c.summary: Lebanon has passed a banking restructuring law, a key reform. The article notes restructuring should have started after the economy crashed in 2019, with reforms previously obstructed by the ruling elite.
n03e1ee9b9c.why: Lebanon's banking system has been in crisis since 2019, and restructuring affects depositors, creditors and the terms of any international financial support.

n71b99c6098.headline: This wasn’t banking, it was witch-hunting - Prof. Lord Mensah blasts sector cleanup
n71b99c6098.summary: A University of Ghana financial economist said the banking sector clean-up failed to follow basic banking principles. He spoke on JoyNews on Wednesday, July 30, criticising the decisions that led to it.
n71b99c6098.why: Ghana's banking clean-up affects depositors, shareholders and the stability of the financial system, and policy debate shapes investor confidence in the sector.

n45784b6a2c.headline: Drax Group Delivers Stable H1 Results And Higher Dividend
n45784b6a2c.summary: Drax Group reported half-year results to 30 June 2025, with adjusted basic EPS of 65.6p. The interim dividend rose 12% to 11.6p.
n45784b6a2c.why: Drax Group operates the Drax power station in North Yorkshire and is a major UK renewable power producer and biomass generator.

nd369c2cbad.headline: NPP arrested Cedi’s fall in 2023 before leaving office - Afenyo-Markin counters budget claims
nd369c2cbad.summary: Minority Leader Alexander Afenyo-Markin questioned Finance Minister Cassiel Ato Forson's claim that the recent cedi appreciation is unprecedented, saying the previous administration had already stabilised the currency.
nd369c2cbad.why: The cedi is Ghana's currency, and its moves affect inflation, import costs and foreign investor returns on Ghanaian assets.

n64b0ed3e9b.headline: Trump says US will set 15% tariff on imports from South Korea
n64b0ed3e9b.summary: President Donald Trump said on Wednesday the US will charge a 15% tariff on imports from South Korea. The announcement was reported from Washington and Seoul.
n64b0ed3e9b.why: South Korea is a major exporter of semiconductors, autos and electronics, so US tariffs on its goods affect Korean exporters and the global trade outlook.
n64b0ed3e9b.why_moved: The US tariff on South Korean imports adds costs for exporters that rely on US demand. The announcement shifts expectations for Korean trade flows.

n4d6293b523.headline: World Bank Unveils Phase 2 of LIFT Project: Boosting MSME Growth and Economic Transformation in Liberia
n4d6293b523.summary: The World Bank has launched phase two of the Line of Credit under Liberia's LIFT Project. The aim is to expand financing for micro, small and medium enterprises and strengthen the financial system.
n4d6293b523.why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender that funds development projects, and credit lines for small firms support private-sector growth in low-income economies.

n6e2edf8e03.headline: Flight Centre profit down as Aussies stay close to home
n6e2edf8e03.summary: Flight Centre expects to miss guidance as leisure travel fell in recent months amid fighting in the Middle East and a global downturn in bookings to the US.
n6e2edf8e03.why: Flight Centre is an Australian travel retailer whose results reflect consumer travel demand and bookings.

n16ccd36678.headline: 'Economic death spiral' fear over ailing copper smelter
n16ccd36678.summary: A delegation is visiting Canberra to plead for a bailout for the copper industry, warning of an economic death spiral at an ailing copper smelter.
n16ccd36678.why: Copper smelters process ore into refined metal, and their viability affects domestic copper supply and regional employment.

n12efa079fd.headline: Millions of Australians at risk of financial hardship in retirement, new report warns
n12efa079fd.summary: More than four million Australians are worried they cannot afford retirement, according to new research showing a growing gap between retirement savings and financial security.
n12efa079fd.why: Retirement savings levels influence household spending, superannuation flows and demand for long-term financial products.

n1ab72a35c6.headline: Jigsaw coming together for further interest rate relief
n1ab72a35c6.summary: A soft inflation reading and surprisingly strong retail sales paint a positive picture of the Australian economy, supporting the case for further interest-rate relief.
n1ab72a35c6.why: Inflation and retail spending data guide the Reserve Bank of Australia's rate settings, which influence Australian bond yields and the Australian dollar.

nb98516a4b4.headline: Jigsaw coming together for further interest rate relief
nb98516a4b4.summary: A soft inflation print and surprisingly strong retail sales paint a rosy picture of the Australian economy. The combination points toward further interest rate relief ahead.
nb98516a4b4.why: Inflation and retail data guide the Reserve Bank of Australia's rate decisions, which affect borrowing costs, the currency and equity valuations.

nd3c288ae43.headline: Australian shares slide as tariff shockwaves hit copper
nd3c288ae43.summary: Australian shares slipped from near-record levels as copper prices plunged after a surprise US tariff decision. The move hit the local market.
nd3c288ae43.why: Australia's benchmark index is heavily weighted toward miners, so commodity price swings flow directly into local equity performance.
nd3c288ae43.why_moved: A surprise US tariff decision triggered a sharp fall in copper prices, weighing on Australian shares that had been near record levels.

n40e7b127e6.headline: FRCS waives $75M in penalties as tax amnesty ends
n40e7b127e6.summary: The Fiji Revenue and Customs Service processed more than 40,000 tax returns during its tax amnesty programme, which has now concluded. It waived $75 million in penalties.
n40e7b127e6.why: Tax amnesties raise government revenue and shape compliance, with implications for fiscal accounts and the business climate.

n4d2a2df535.headline: ArcelorMittal posts $1.86 billion quarterly earnings, trims steel demand outlook
n4d2a2df535.summary: ArcelorMittal beat earnings expectations with $1.86 billion for Q2 2025 but cut its global steel demand forecast. The company cited weaker US consumption and trade measures.
n4d2a2df535.why: ArcelorMittal is one of the world's largest steelmakers, so its demand outlook is a read-through for construction, autos and industrial activity.

nc4cdb06d73.headline: Food prices are rising, the economy is slowing, and the Fed is standing pat. What’s next? - The Boston Globe
nc4cdb06d73.summary: A flood of economic data this week pointed to slowing consumer spending and a softening labour market. Food prices are rising, and more tariffs were also noted.
nc4cdb06d73.why: The Federal Reserve sets US short-term interest rates, and the pace of inflation, spending and jobs data shapes its policy path and asset prices.

n5890a5fcf8.headline: National Bank of Greece Raises 2025 Loan Target to €2.5B
n5890a5fcf8.summary: National Bank of Greece raised its 2025 loan growth target to €2.5 billion. The bank also announced plans for an interim dividend for Q4 2025.
n5890a5fcf8.why: National Bank of Greece is one of Greece's largest lenders, so its loan growth and dividend plans signal credit demand and shareholder returns in the Greek banking sector.

impacts.name: National Bank of Greece
impacts.why: Raised loan growth target and planned interim dividend are guidance changes for the bank's lending and payouts.

n8f63b19a83.headline: France Grants Ghana Debt Relief
n8f63b19a83.summary: France has officially granted debt relief to Ghana under the country's external debt restructuring programme. The bilateral agreement was signed between the two countries.
n8f63b19a83.why: Bilateral debt relief reduces Ghana's external debt burden, affecting its public finances, sovereign bonds and borrowing costs.

n1052c5bbcd.headline: Trump’s tariffs on India: ‘Many exporters might face order cancellations or pressure to…’, says expert on India’s textile sector
n1052c5bbcd.summary: A textile sector expert warned many Indian exporters may face order cancellations or pressure over Trump's tariffs, which are linked to India's purchases of Russian crude oil and military equipment.
n1052c5bbcd.why: India is a large textile exporter, and US tariffs directly affect the margins and order books of apparel and textile manufacturers.

n2776543491.headline: Food prices up an estimated 4.6% in July - CSO
n2776543491.summary: Food prices are estimated to have risen 4.6% over the last 12 months, according to new figures from the Central Statistics Office.
n2776543491.why: Food inflation feeds into overall consumer price inflation, which influences Irish interest rate expectations and household spending.

n789d023c35.headline: US data centers to drive electricity demand to record levels
n789d023c35.summary: Data centers' rising power needs, combined with higher natural gas prices, mean more power plants are switching from gas back to coal.
n789d023c35.why: Natural gas is a key fuel for US power generation, and data center growth is raising electricity demand across the country.

n2776b33c7f.headline: Merck unveils $3bn cost-cutting plan to support pipeline and new product launches
n2776b33c7f.summary: Merck has approved a restructuring programme aimed at cutting costs by $3 billion. The plan is intended to support its pipeline and new product launches.
n2776b33c7f.why: Merck is a large US-based pharmaceutical company, and its drug pipeline and product launches drive its revenue and investor valuation.

n0969874bb8.headline: IMF raises global growth forecast two tenths to 3% for 2025 and one tenth to 3.1% for 2026
n0969874bb8.summary: The IMF raised its global GDP growth forecast to 3.0% for 2025, up from 2.8% in April, and to 3.1% for 2026. The revisions were announced in its latest update.
n0969874bb8.why: The IMF is the Washington-based lender whose global growth forecasts are widely used by investors, central banks and governments to frame economic outlooks.

nb59054c42c.headline: Ringgit ends lower against US dollar as Fed holds interest rate steady
nb59054c42c.summary: The ringgit reversed its morning gains to end lower against the US dollar on Thursday. The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate steady overnight.
nb59054c42c.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its exchange rate with the US dollar is sensitive to US interest rate decisions and capital flows.

na43080a45f.headline: German Inflation Remains Steady at 2% in July
na43080a45f.summary: German inflation remained steady at 2% in July, according to preliminary data. The eurozone is weighing its next steps after last week's decision to keep interest rates unchanged.
na43080a45f.why: Germany is the eurozone's largest economy, and its inflation readings feed into European Central Bank rate decisions that affect bond yields and the euro.

n85f52afeb0.headline: Bundestag Approves EUR1 Billion for Bridge Renovations, Avoiding Delays
n85f52afeb0.summary: The Bundestag has approved EUR1 billion for bridge renovation work, according to the report. The funding is intended to avoid delays to the projects.
n85f52afeb0.why: Germany's federal budget and infrastructure spending shape demand for construction firms and the country's fiscal outlook for investors.

nfc558fb616.headline: German inflation unchanged at 2% in July
nfc558fb616.summary: German inflation remained unchanged at 2% in July, according to preliminary data. Euro zone rate-setters are weighing their next steps after holding rates last week following a string of cuts.
nfc558fb616.why: Inflation data feeds into European Central Bank policy decisions, which affect euro interest rates and bond yields.

n5f305f63e2.headline: Experts: Be wise with extra cash
n5f305f63e2.summary: Financial and consumer groups say Bank Negara's interest rate cut gives Malaysians a chance to turn loan repayment savings into emergency funds. The groups argue this would bring lasting financial stability.
n5f305f63e2.why: Bank Negara Malaysia is the central bank that sets the country's benchmark interest rate, affecting loan costs and household cash flow.

n91748f7ffb.headline: Good news for SMEs with cash flow problems
n91748f7ffb.summary: An industry group says Bank Negara's rate cut gives SMEs a crucial boost amid global uncertainty, helping them manage cash flow and emergency funds.
n91748f7ffb.why: Bank Negara Malaysia is the central bank, and its policy rate influences borrowing costs for businesses and households across the economy.

nffe1573685.headline: Keith Christman Discusses Pending Duties for Engineered Hardwood from Vietnam and Indonesia
nffe1573685.summary: Pending anti-dumping and countervailing duties on engineered hardwood from China, Vietnam and Indonesia could be retroactive and cost importers more than expected, the exact amounts not yet announced.
nffe1573685.why: Anti-dumping and countervailing duties are tariffs imposed on imports judged to be sold below fair value or subsidised. They raise costs for importers and can reshape sourcing.

n15d29c85e4.headline: Canada’s AI safety institute pledges $1 million to UK counterpart for research collaboration
n15d29c85e4.summary: Canada's AI safety institute pledged $1 million to its UK counterpart for a research collaboration. Yoshua Bengio joined the advisory board of the $29-million research initiative.
n15d29c85e4.why: AI safety institutes study risks from advanced AI systems, and government-backed research shapes future AI regulation and standards.
